_comment: Item merge list (swap lists 'merges', SwapLists.java; feature_writeup/item_merges.md 6): both items stay registered; the old one is purged and the survivor takes over its recipes, loot and tags (CD startup script creativedelight/swap_merges.js) and every stack of it in the world (Common swap/ItemMerges). Applied only while every 'requires' mod is loaded. Never prune: an old world whose old item is later unregistered is remapped from this list. Brewin' and Chewin's Pickled Pickles go into the Pickled Sea Pickle; one salt (The Salt's salt into Vintage's pink salt dust, Vintage's Salt Block into The Salt's, 2.9); mason jars only: the removed bottles go into their jars (dishes/jams #1; the nut mash bottle, merges/dishes #7).
